verdienmodellen.sub: Lemnion doesn't only deliver batteries and chargers. We also create new revenue models for your hotel, from direct revenue to smart marketing on the go.
verdienmodellen.v1p: Install chargers or fast chargers at your hotel and earn per charging session. Guests, passers-by and neighbours charge with you, giving you 24/7 income without extra effort.
verdienmodellen.v2p: Offer a guaranteed charging point when booking a room. A service that convinces guests to choose your hotel and adds revenue per room.
verdienmodellen.v3p: Fast chargers have large screens. Show a promo from your F&B or a discount on a night's stay while guests wait. Direct conversion while they charge.
verdienmodellen.v4p: The Lemnion EMS connects via APIs to your Property Management System. Create smart upsell packages: charger + room + breakfast in one booking.
verdienmodellen.cta-h2: Put your parking lot to work
verdienmodellen.cta-p: Chargers are more than a facility: they are a revenue model and a marketing channel. Let us show what they can add to your hotel.
